disks.title: CuteMouse 2.1 driver
disks.description: A freeware DOS mouse driver for this machine's serial mouse on COM1. FDAUTO already loads it from C:; this floppy is for MOUSETST and a fresh copy.
disks.license: GPL. Taken from the FreeDOS distribution this machine already ships.
disks.help:
FDAUTO already runs CTMOUSE at boot. Tick Mouse on the page and
click the screen for pointer lock.

  A:\MOUSETST        check it sees movement
  A:\CTMOUSE         load again if you unloaded it

Do not use /P (that is for PS/2).

disks.title: FreeDOS Games
disks.description: Small games that run on a 286 with EGA: Senet, Hangman, Eliza, Zmiy and ViTetris. They run straight off the floppy.
disks.license: Free software (GPL, BSD or public domain, per program). See README.TXT on the disk.
disks.help:
Run them straight from A:

  A:\SENET\SENET          Egyptian board game
  A:\HANGMAN\HANGMAN      hangman, in EGA
  A:\ELIZA\ELIZA          the 1960s chatbot
  A:\ZMIY\ZMIY            a snake game
  A:\VITETRIS\TETRIS16    Tetris

For Tetris, load the ANSI driver first:
  DEVLOAD C:\FREEDOS\BIN\NANSI.SYS

TETRIS.EXE on the same disk wants a 386. Use TETRIS16 here.

disks.title: FreeDOS Editors and Tools
disks.description: Doszip Commander, a two-pane file manager, plus the e3 and Freemacs editors and the uHex hex editor.
disks.license: Free software (GPL or BSD, per program). See README.TXT on the disk.
disks.help:
A:\DOSZIP\DZ            Doszip Commander. F10 quits
  A:\E3\E3 FILE.TXT       WordStar-style editor
  A:\UHEX\UHEX FILE       hex editor

Freemacs builds its .ED files the first time,
so run it from its own directory and answer Y:

  A:
  CD \FREEMACS
  EMACS
